title: Security Quarantine Payload (v1) — Security-quarantine-plane entity
description: Phase 16 / §7 — Quarantined records (flagged as suspicious or invalid). Per SCRAPER_PATCHER.md, the patcher's diagnostic bundle includes quarantine samples. Quarantine records are tombstoned at sink-time and not served to the swarm.

original_stable_id.description: stable_id of the original record that was quarantined.

metadata.description: Additional context (error message, field that failed, etc.).

quarantined_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the record was quarantined.
